about: Construct receivers (Constructs/Parts/Weapons) side by side in one plane, facing the same way, in an NxN square (N >= minSize) merge into one receiver drawn N times bigger with one centre socket set; the gun parts on its centre sockets are drawn and simulated N times bigger too. The sound block is the report of an NxN gun (steps = N-1 up to maxSteps): pitch = (1+steps)^-pitchExp, not below minPitch; bassDbPerStep: bass up against the highs, each step (the highs are rolled off by that much); gainDbPerStep louder; rangePerStep heard further. Each number in powers below is a power of N: the merged gun's value is the single receiver's times N to that power (2: N squared, -1: divided by N, 0: unchanged). docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Merged receivers'.
